title: Need help with 3d modelling
author: danihyder47
selftext:
Hi, everyone! Apologies in advance if this post doesn’t belong here, but I really need help with creating 3D models. I am really a beginner in this, but I’m experimenting and learning along the way.

I have been struggling to create a proper 3D mesh for my characters. I am using ComfyUI workflows with local image and 3D models. I have tried Qwen image, Trellis 2 with textures, Flux2, Pixel 3D, Hunyuan3D v2.1, but I’m really struggling to get the results I want for my characters. I also tried with a single reference image to create a 3D mesh with texture maps.

I want to also try a multiview image to 3D, but for that I need to create a turnaround sheet first, which is also a hassle itself using AI. I really don’t want to pay for any APIs or any online apps such as meshy AI or tripo3D, and I am also constrained due to the 6GB VRam, but it does work fine with all the above mentioned models.

I also am trying to learn to do it in blender, but it’s a steep learning curve, and I am planning to create bunch of 3D meshes for the game assets, so I am working on creating a workable pipeline for my project.

Any suggestions, ideas or any open source pipelines can be shared here. 

Once again apologies for being a noob here. Thank you!

comments.author: HallucinatedGames
comments.body: I have similar setup, 8GB VRAM so I am constrained locally. Honestly what I have found doing several hundred models and a few hobby project games, is if your unhappy with quality of the outputs you need more VRAM / better GPU. I also pay for hugging face pro, which lets me monkey around with GPU’s online and I can see the big difference. Same inputs to trellis, drastically better models from higher quant models etc. I think you’ll likely have to upgrade your card or go to a service. Not probably the answer you want to hear, but it’s what I have experienced. Ultimately I am ok with lower quality outputs locally given cost, privacy, and it’s just hobby / family game hacking. Best of luck.

replies.author: danihyder47
replies.body: Thanks so much! How is your experience so far on hugging face pro account? In terms of queue and the number of 3D models you can create per day? What spaces do you usually use there?

replies.author: HallucinatedGames
replies.body: I pay about 10 dollars, gets me 40 minutes of compute. That gets me around 40 models on trellis 2.0 daily to generate and extract the GLB. It’s fine for a few models I want to really look good (e.g. Models from my kids faces, etc). I use this space quite a bit it’s official MSFT Trellis https://huggingface.co/spaces/microsoft/TRELLIS.2 but I run my local pipeline fir generating mass stuff like environments, props, etc where I’d worry about the credits / compute.

replies.author: danihyder47
replies.body: Thanks for sharing it. I'll definitely have a look at this option.
